name: Fegex
rootCause: FEGex's SmartBridge was exploited across Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Base on Dec 29, 2024, allowing an attacker to withdraw tokens by spoofing admin authority via cross-chain messages. The attacker drained about $1.07M in assets, converting them to native tokens and funneling proceeds to Tornado Cash. The FEG bridge relayer accepted admin privileges from an untrusted message payload, enabling an attacker-controlled contract to be whitelisted and register unbacked withdrawals across chains. There was no independent verification of sender authority.
